root_cause.condition: ISS returns table error 'play : _game_not_started' after a prior game has already reached terminal state and its active-game authority has been removed, while the worker is trying to ready the same table for the next game.
root_cause.prior_behavior: Raise ISS_TABLE_ERROR_WITHOUT_ACTIVE_GAME and terminate the whole worker.
root_cause.scientific_effect: No game result is created, changed, recovered, or scored by this correction. The defect is session/table lifecycle only.

preconditions: no active assignment for the table/game key
error belongs to the currently admitted table
recovery: clear expected-new-table and ephemeral table password
send leave for the stale table
reuse existing DESTROY handler to create the next table
fail_closed_preserved: all other no-active table errors still raise
all active-game table errors still persist PROTOCOL_FAILURE and raise

cases: exact no-active _game_not_started recovers without worker crash
active-game table error remains protocol failure and stops worker

deployment_rule: Do not stop or mutate the current live worker. After commit/push, repoint only the pinned launcher so the refrozen source is used on the next natural worker start. Record and verify the first post-boundary game source identity and B0/B1 balance.
rollback: Restore launcher ROOT/EXPECTED to a49232c worktree/commit; current pre-cutover worker is already unchanged.
